topic: A person's invention is already patented by someone else
text: They came to me, claiming their invention, a godsend they said, was snatched right from under their nose, patented by some slick operator. I listened, poured them a drink, let the rain hiss against the window. In this city, ideas are like cabs in a storm—everybody’s waiting for one and they all look the same. I told them, "You’re not the first to get the door slammed in your face," and handed them a file. "Here’s your man. I’ve been watching him. Might even have a lead on his next move." They looked at the papers, and there was something in their eyes—probably the only thing that makes this job worth the long nights. "Thanks, I didn’t know you believed in second chances," they said. I just nodded, poured myself a drink, and watched them go, thinking about the next case already.
